acceptanceCriteria: An intent can cite a requirement-ID subset of a spec over the 256 bound, and the subset is checked against the same bound
Omitting an over-bound spec is reported as a named NOT_PRODUCED row rather than silent
body: Lane attempt-1021h (PR #1452, ATR-V0-193 in the attempt-runner spec; it also touched the leases spec) had to leave docs/specs/corvint-tasks-agent-leases-v0.md out of the dogfood intents because its 258 requirements exceed the 256 obligation bound. Owner 2026-10-17 kept the bound and re-homes new requirements to domain specs, so the bound stays. Expected: an intent can name a requirement subset (the IDs the change touches) of an over-bound spec instead of being refused or omitted. Actual: the whole spec is refused, and the binding silently loses that intent.
title: dogfood: a spec with more than 256 requirements cannot be listed as an intent, so changes to it bind without that spec
